# CVArchitect

> Autonomous AI Resume Agent and Direct Career-Page Job Intelligence Platform. Tailor your resume to any job in seconds without hallucinating experience or stuffing keywords.

CVArchitect (https://cvarchitect.app) is an agentic resume architecture and direct job-search middleware platform. Unlike traditional static template builders, CVArchitect operates an autonomous agent loop that analyzes job postings, verifies authentic candidate experience, frames metrics in Google XYZ format, simulates ATS scoring (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo), and fetches live job postings directly from employer career pages.

## Key Capabilities & Systems

- **Autonomous Resume Agent**: Paste any job description or select a posting from the live feed. The agent extracts seniority signals, core competencies, and keyword requirements, then rewrites bullets with strict zero-hallucination guardrails.
- **Direct Career-Page Job Feed**: Fetches 8,500+ verified tech and professional job postings directly from company career pages and modern ATS portals (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday) with verified salary data, remote filters, and instant 1-Click Resume Tailoring.
- **Grounded Evidence Engine**: Every bullet rewrite traces to authentic user history. The engine verifies projects, roles, and metrics before editing—blocking invented claims, inflated titles, or keyword stuffing.
- **Google XYZ Impact Bullet Optimizer**: Automatically reframes passive job descriptions into measurable business achievements ("Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]").
- **ATS Match Scorecard & Simulation**: Real-time compatibility rating (0–100%) scored against the exact parsing rules of Workday, Taleo, Lever, and Greenhouse.
- **Interactive Drag & Drop Resume Studio**: 10+ ATS-tuned typographic templates (Harvard Classic, Executive Pro, Vanguard, Modern Minimalist, Tech Developer, Student Fresh Grad) with pixel-perfect PDF and editable DOCX export.
- **Tailored Cover Letter Generator**: Generates concise, role-specific cover letters aligned with the company's stated mission and requirements in under 30 seconds.
- **Interview Intelligence**: Synthesizes likely STAR-method behavioural and technical interview questions grounded in the tailored resume and target job posting.

## Direct Career-Page Job Search Feed

CVArchitect provides an integrated live job feed (`https://cvarchitect.app/#jobs`) that indexes opportunities straight from company career sites:
- **Zero Aggregator Noise**: Direct links to original employer application pages.
- **Real-Time 1-Click Tailor**: Clicking "Tailor Resume" on any job card immediately loads the role's context and requirements into the Resume Agent for automated alignment.
- **Categories Covered**: AI & Machine Learning, Full-Stack & Systems Engineering, Product Design, Growth & Marketing, Data & Analytics, and 100% Remote Opportunities.

## Pricing & Access Tiers

- **Foundation Free Tier**: 1 fully tailored AI resume on base ATS templates with complete download. No credit card required.
- **Career Sprint ($6/week)**: Full unlimited AI agent tailoring, job matching, all 10+ templates, and unlimited PDF/DOCX exports.
- **Career Build ($20/month)**: Continuous unlimited tailoring, saved resume versions, live career-page tracking, and cover letter generator. Cancel anytime.
- **Lifetime Pass ($99 one-time)**: Permanent unlimited access to all current and future agent models and templates.
